battle.name: 李淵剿撫汾晉起義軍
battle.brief: 隋大業十一年夏秋，汾州、晉州一帶饑民聚眾作亂，圍攻州郡治所。太原留守李淵奉詔率兵南下，以連弩列於城垣壓住叛軍攻勢，繼而分道進剿，並招撫脅從、發糧復業。此役為李淵在山西立下軍功，也使他握有一支可用之兵。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，一踩一發。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 交戰的一方是隋朝官軍，主力為北都太原留守李淵所部。隋承北周府兵之制，戰時由行軍總管與總管府調兵遣將，太原留守署兼節制汾州、晉州等山西諸郡，兵源包括軍府番上之卒、郡縣鄉兵、屯田戍卒與蕃漢編戶，步卒以材官為主、騎兵以驃騎為先，糧秣由晉陽、絳州一線的屯田與漕運供應。另一方是汾州、晉州一帶的起義眾：連年徭役、兵役與饑荒之下，逃戶、匠戶、屯丁與不滿的本地豪族糾合成股，沒有常備編制，只推首領行事，以山寨、塢堡和州縣城牆為依託，分股游走於汾水兩岸，多備刀矛、勁弓與簡陋的雲梯、檑木，攻城能力有限。其時北方有突厥大軍壓境，河北有竇建德，江淮有杜伏威，遼東高句麗戰事未罷，山西是南北各方都要爭奪的兵源與糧倉地帶，官軍與叛軍在此寸土必爭。
countriesEn: One side was the Sui field force, its main body the troops under Li Yuan, garrison commander of the Northern Capital at Taiyuan. Sui had inherited the fubing militia system of the Northern Zhou, and in war a xingjun zongguan or a zongguanfu issued the orders and drew out the units; the Taiyuan garrison office in effect controlled the troops of Fen Prefecture, Jin Prefecture and the other Shanxi commanderies, drawing on soldiers mustered by rotation from the military households, on commandery and county militia, on garrison and settlement-farm men, and on enrolled Han and non-Han households. The foot soldiers were drilled as caiguan, the horse as piaoji light cavalry, and the grain came from the settlement farms and the transport line through Jinyang and Jiangzhou. The other side was the insurgents of Fen and Jin: after years of forced labour, conscription and famine, runaway households, artisan households, farm hands and resentful local gentry had pooled into bands with no standing establishment, obeying only leaders they chose themselves, holding out in stockades, fortified farmsteads and the walled seats of commanderies, and moving in separate groups along both banks of the Fen river, armed with knives, spears, strong bows and crude ladders and battering logs, with little capacity for siege work. At the same moment the Turks massed in the north, Dou Jiande operated in the Hebei plain, Du Fuwei held the Yangzi valley, and the war against Goguryeo in Liaodong was still undecided; Shanxi was a prize of manpower and grain for every faction, and here the government and the insurgents fought for every strip of ground.
people: 關鍵人物首推李淵，字叔淵，隴西成紀人，仕隋多年，大業中出為太原留守，總督北都軍政，此時主持對汾晉起義的處置。次為隋煬帝楊廣，其時正巡狩塞北，太原是隨駕大軍的糧械總匯與後方根本，起義爆發之際，朝廷主力正屯於崞縣一線與突厥相持，詔書下達與軍報往返都極迂緩。北方強敵是突厥始畢可汗，其年七月率數萬騎兵逼近崞縣，其妻義成公主遣使往來、勸其退兵，是牽動全局的變數。地方上，汾州刺史、晉州刺史與各縣令或守城待援、或隨軍出走、或棄署而去，態度不一。起義首領的姓名在《隋書》《舊唐書》與《資治通鑑》中多所訛漏，僅知汾、晉兩州各有數名首謀者，彼此號令不一，聚散無常。追隨李淵的參軍、記室與諸校尉多出身北方行伍，負責規劃出兵、分派糧械，並在戰後經手勸誘招撫之事。
peopleEn: The central figure is Li Yuan, courtesy name Shuyuan, a native of Chengji in Longxi, long in Sui service, who in the Daye era was appointed garrison commander of Taiyuan and held overall military authority over the Northern Capital; he directed the suppression of the Fen and Jin rising. Next comes Emperor Yang of Sui, Yang Guang, who was then touring the northern frontier; Taiyuan was the muster and supply hub of the army that followed the imperial court, and the rising broke out while the main Sui force was pinned against the Turks near Heng County, so the passage of edicts and the return of reports were extremely slow. The great northern enemy was the Turkic qaghan Shibi, who that July led tens of thousands of riders up to Heng County; his wife, the wise princess Yicheng, sent envoys back and forth and urged him to withdraw, and he was the variable that moved the whole situation. Locally, the governors of Fen and Jin and the magistrates of the counties either shut themselves in the walled seats awaiting relief, or marched out with the troops, or abandoned their posts; their conduct was not uniform. The names of the insurgent leaders are badly garbled in the Suishu, the Jiu Tangshu and the Zizhi Tongjian; all that is certain is that Fen and Jin each had several ringleaders whose orders did not agree with one another and who gathered and scattered at will. The zhangjun, jishi and junior commanders who followed Li Yuan mostly came out of northern military households; they planned the deployment, allocated grain and equipment, and afterwards handled the business of inducing the insurgents to surrender.
kits: 卡面這具秦連弩是弩機連發的制式器械：以踏板與槓桿把弩弦的拉力預先儲存，取用時一踩一發，箭矢由矢匣連續送出，有效射程約百步至百五十步；其形制見於戰國至秦的銅弩機，出土於關中與楚地墓葬，隋人稱之為連弩，唐人則歸入床子弩一類。連弩的好處是守城時射速高，可以在城頭以交叉火網把接近城基、攀上雲梯的攻城者壓在牆外；壞處是連發之後須整具重新上弦，精度不及單發勁弩，箭矢消耗亦快，一次齊射便要補上數十支箭，因此只在城頭掩體之後或弩陣前出時密集使用。與之並用的是蹶張弩、機弩等單發重弩，專射城門、射樓與密集隊形；野戰配以槊、刀、盾與拒馬、鹿角，攻城則用雲梯、檑木、撞車、投石機與飛樓，並備輜重車以運糧秣，備鼓號旗幟以傳號令。
kitsEn: The repeating crossbow on the card is a standard weapon that stores the draw of the bowstring: a treadle and lever hold the tension in advance, and each time the operator stamps the pedal one bolt is released, the shafts running out of the magazine in sequence, with a useful range of roughly one hundred to one hundred and fifty paces. Its form is known from the bronze crossbow triggers of the Warring States and Qin periods excavated from tombs in the Guanzhong and Chu regions; the Sui called it a liannu, the Tang filed it under the chuangzi crossbow. The virtue of the weapon is its rate of fire in defence: from the ramparts it can lay down a cross-fire that pins attackers against the base of the wall or drives them off the scaling ladders before they can climb. Its drawbacks are that the whole mechanism must be re-cocked after a volley, that its accuracy is below that of a single-shot strong crossbow, and that it burns shafts fast, a single volley costing dozens of arrows; it was therefore used in mass only from behind cover on the walls or when a crossbow line advanced ahead of the formation. Alongside it stood single-shot heavy crossbows such as the zuzhang and the ji crossbow, devoted to the gates, the shooting towers and massed formations. In the field the Sui troops carried spears, sabres, shields, chevaux-de-frise and antler barriers; for the attack they brought scaling ladders, battering logs, rams, traction trebuchets and flying towers, together with baggage wagons for grain and drums, horns and banners for signalling.
tactics: 官軍的處置分守城與進剿兩層。守城一面，把連弩分作數段配置於城頭，對城門、馬道、雲梯接近點與牆根實行交叉射界，壓住叛軍攻勢，並以拒馬、鹿角與陷坑設於城門內側，減少被衝入的機會；一面以信騎與烽火往來通報，使援軍與糧運及時抵達。出剿採分道進兵：步兵結方陣緩推，連弩營隨軍前出，射一陣而退，誘使叛軍離開城池進入伏擊地；騎兵則繞行山谷，切斷其糧道與屯聚所在，逼其不得不在糧盡之前轉進或潰散。待叛軍因缺糧而離散，官方改以撫為主：赦免脅從，發糧復業，編戶為民，令其歸田，並把一部份降眾編入屯田與郡兵，使亂兵轉為官軍的兵源。最後以騎兵追擊潰散至山澤者。全役自起事到肅清，前後延續數月才告結束。
tacticsEn: The government response worked on two levels, holding the walls and hunting the bands. For the defence, the crossbows were broken into several sections posted along the ramparts, laying overlapping fields of fire over the gates, the ramp approaches, the points where the ladders were set and the foot of the wall, while chevaux-de-frise, antler barriers and pits were dug inside the gates to reduce the chance of a breach; couriers and beacon fires passed the news in both directions so that reinforcements and grain would arrive in time. For the advance the Sui marched in separate columns: the infantry closed into square formations and pressed forward slowly, a crossbow detachment moved ahead, loosed a volley and withdrew, luring the insurgents out of the towns and into ground chosen for ambush; the horse meanwhile swung through the valleys to cut their supply lines and the villages where they stored grain, forcing them to advance or dissolve before their food ran out. Once the insurgents began to break up for want of grain, the court changed to a policy of pacification: the coerced were pardoned, grain was issued, the population was re-registered and returned to the fields, and part of the surrendered men were enrolled in the settlement farms and the commandery militia, so that rebels were turned into soldiers. Finally the cavalry pursued those who scattered into the hills and ravines. From the outbreak of the rising to the last clean-up the whole business took several months.
data: 關於兵員，兩《唐書》與《資治通鑑》對此役只作「李淵擊平汾晉賊」一類的概略記載，不載確數，只能就制度與常例推其量級：隋代一郡之兵通常在數千至一萬之間，太原署所領的精兵當以數千計，其中騎兵為數百至千餘之數；起義眾則由數十股組成，總數自數千至數萬不等，因無編制而人數浮動極大。地理上，晉陽至汾州治隰縣約二百五十至三百里，至晉州治翼城約三百五十至四百里，汾水自北而南縱貫其間，順流而下數日可達，逆流則倍之。戰役歷時以月計，跨越大業十一年的夏、秋兩季。消耗方面，攻城與野戰的連弩齊射使箭矢損耗以數萬支計，輜重與運糧車隊達千乘量級；損兵數目史無明文，只知起義主力潰散、被執與散入山澤者以千計，官軍則幾乎沒有成建制的損失。同年的背景數字是：七月突厥大軍逼近崞縣，隋煬帝被圍其地；此前大業八年第一次征高句麗，渡鴨綠水之師已達三十餘萬，至此仍未竟功。
dataEn: On numbers of men, the two Tang histories and the Zizhi Tongjian record this campaign only in broad strokes, in the manner of Li Yuan striking down the Fen and Jin bandits, without exact figures, so the scale can only be inferred from institutional practice and the normal run of things. A single Sui commandery commonly carried between several thousand and ten thousand men; the picked troops under the Taiyuan office must have numbered in the thousands, with the cavalry somewhere between several hundred and a little over a thousand. The insurgents came together in a few dozen bands, the total anywhere from several thousand to tens of thousands, and since they had no establishment the figure swung wildly. Geographically, Jinyang lies about two hundred and fifty to three hundred li from the seat of Fen Prefecture at Xixian, and about three hundred and fifty to four hundred li from the seat of Jin Prefecture at Yicheng, with the Fen river running north to south between them: downstream it could be floated in a matter of days, upstream it took twice as long. The campaign lasted a matter of months, running through the summer and autumn of the eleventh year of Daye. In expenditure, the massed crossbow fire in the assaults and in the field used up tens of thousands of shafts, and the baggage and grain trains ran to something like a thousand wagons; the losses in men are not stated in the histories, and all that is known is that the main body of the insurgents was broken up, with a thousand or so taken or scattered into the hills, while the government army lost practically nothing in formed units. The background figures for the same year are these: in July the Turkic host closed on Heng County and Emperor Yang was invested there; and before that, in the first campaign against Goguryeo in the eighth year of Daye, the Sui force that crossed the Yalu numbered more than three hundred thousand men, and by 615 the war was still unwon.
cause: 起義並非偶然。隋朝自開皇末以來已埋下四道裂痕：一是三征高句麗與兩征吐谷渾，府庫耗竭而役夫死亡以百萬計；二是營建東都、洛陽與開鑿渠道、漕運，徭役隨之暴增，北運的糧船又常被沿途官吏截留；三是北旱南澇、蝗災相仍，糧價騰貴；四是州縣為完成上計而括戶、括丁，逃戶與逃丁成為流民之主。汾州、晉州一帶正當河東漕運的門戶，鹽池、屯田與軍糧倉廩盡在省中，徵發的密度遠高於他處，農民既失其業又失其時，一旦有人倡首，響應便極迅速。與此同時，隋煬帝把主力兵馬調往塞北與遼東，山西只剩留守兵力，一旦起義席捲州縣，郡兵往往數日之內即告瓦解，叛亂遂由一縣蔓延至數州。李淵出兵，不過是因為他是當地唯一能迅速集兵的人，而不是朝廷刻意加強山西防務的結果。
causeEn: The rising was no accident. Since the closing years of the Kaihuang era the Sui had four fissures running through it. First, the three campaigns against Goguryeo and the two against the Tuyuhun drained the treasury to the dregs while the corvee died in the hundreds of thousands. Second, the building of the eastern capital and Luoyang, the cutting of new canals and the grain transport brought forced labour soaring, and the grain barges running north were repeatedly detained by local officials along the route. Third, drought in the north, flooding in the south and locusts came on top of one another, and grain prices rose out of all reason. Fourth, the commanderies and counties, in order to report the quotas they had met, rounded up households and pressed men into service, and the runaways became the raw material of the displaced. Fen and Jin sat at the gateway of the eastern transport route, with the salt pans, the settlement farms and the military granaries all in government hands, and the rate at which they were drawn upon was far higher than elsewhere; the peasants had lost both their trade and their season, and once one man raised the cry the response was very quick. At the same time Emperor Yang had carried the bulk of the field army away to the northern frontier and to Liaodong, leaving only the garrison in Shanxi; once the rising swept over the commandery seats the county troops often dissolved within a few days, and the rebellion spread from a single county across several prefectures. Li Yuan was sent out not because the court had deliberately reinforced Shanxi, but because he was the only man locally able to gather troops quickly.
impact: 此役的短期效果是汾、晉兩州治所復歸官府，被擄走的州縣吏員與被掠的器物得以回錄，編戶復業，汾水流域的漕運與屯田重新運作，晉陽到河東的軍糧線得以貫通，隋朝在山西的統治暫時穩住。對李淵個人而言，這是一場收益極大的軍事歷練：他以寡軍平亂，兵不血刃者有之，卻藉此擴充了常備兵與屯田戶，收羅了北方行伍的舊人與亡命，也取得禦亂有功的名聲與朝廷的褒賞，權柄與聲望同步膨脹。此後數年，山西的兵源、馬匹與糧秣都經他的手調度，兩年後晉陽起兵的物資基礎，正是在這幾年裡累積而成的。從全局看，這場平叛延續了隋朝以地方大員代替中央鎮壓的慣例，地方軍頭的權力越來越大，國家對地方軍隊的依賴越來越深；流民再編為民之後，緊接着又在兩三年內捲入新一輪的叛亂洪流，起義的種子並未真正清除，只是被壓回地下。
impactEn: The immediate effect was that the seats of Fen and Jin returned to government hands; the officials who had been carried off and the goods that had been plundered were recovered and recorded, the population was re-registered and returned to work, the transport route and the settlement farms along the Fen river began to run again, and the grain line from Jinyang into Hedong was restored, so that Sui rule in Shanxi was momentarily steady. For Li Yuan personally the campaign was an enormous military gain: he had put down the rising with a small force, in places without shedding much blood, yet by it he expanded his standing troops and his settlement-farm population, gathered the old soldiers of the northern army and the men who had lost their households, and acquired the reputation of one who had quelled a disturbance, together with the court's rewards; authority and renown grew together. In the years that followed, the manpower, horses and grain of Shanxi were all moved at his word, and the material base for the uprising in Jinyang two years later had been accumulated during exactly those years. Seen from the whole, the suppression carried on the Sui habit of letting great local officials do the work of central repression; the power of the local warlords grew steadily, and the state grew steadily more dependent on regional troops. The displaced, re-registered as ordinary people, were drawn into a fresh wave of rebellion within two or three years; the seed of the rising was never truly rooted out, only pressed back underground.
result: 結果是叛軍主力在缺糧與分進合擊之下潰散：一部在攻城戰中被殲於州縣城下，一部被俘後受審降附，一部散入呂梁山與汾水上游的山澤，官軍不可能將其一網打盡。官府收編的辦法是討撫並用四字：討，是出兵追擊殘部、掃清沿途山寨；撫，是赦免脅從、給糧贖罪、令歸田里，把降眾編入屯田與郡兵，並重新配置汾、晉二州的刺史與縣吏。對李淵而言，這是一份厚禮：朝廷以功加賞，進授其尚書令之職，加重其在山西的權柄，隨後數年他不斷招兵練兵、置屯蓄馬，把北都經營成一座不亞於關中的兵源基地。但亂局本身並未因此結束。兩年後（617），劉武周自馬邑南下，先取晉州，再進逼太原，晉陽危殆，李淵才被迫在關中另起根基；這說明汾晉之亂只是隋末亂局的一環節，李淵的晉陽兵威，最終還要靠另一場更大的戰役去證明。
resultEn: The outcome was that the main body of the insurgents dissolved under the pressure of hunger and of attacks delivered from several directions: some were destroyed in the fighting beneath the commandery seats, some were taken and interrogated and enrolled, some scattered into the Luliang mountains and the ravines of the upper Fen, and the government could not possibly net them all in. The method of dealing with the defeated was the four characters punish and pacify together. To punish meant to send troops after the remnants and to clear the stockades along the line of march. To pacify meant to pardon those who had been coerced, to issue grain and redeem their offences, to send them home to their fields, to enrol the surrendered among the settlement farms and the commandery militia, and to reappoint the governors and magistrates of Fen and Jin. For Li Yuan this was a handsome gift: the court rewarded his service, advanced him to the post of Shangshu Ling, and increased his authority in Shanxi, and for the next several years he went on raising and drilling troops, opening settlement farms and breeding horses, turning the Northern Capital into a base for manpower no inferior to the one he would build in Guanzhong. The disorder itself, however, was not over. Two years later, in 617, Liu Wuzhou came south from Mayi, took Jin Prefecture first and then drove up to Taiyuan, and Jinyang was in danger; Li Yuan was compelled to make a fresh start in Guanzhong. The rising in Fen and Jin, in other words, was only one link in the chain of the Sui's collapse, and the martial renown of Li Yuan in Jinyang still had to be proved in a far greater battle.
